en.title: Serbia snow this week: a short white weekend on Zlatibor, Kopaonik still waiting
en.description: Tornik on Zlatibor had up to 39 cm on its upper slopes on 15 November 2026; by Wednesday it had melted. Kopaonik barely turned white. The week day by day and what comes next.
en.lede: Serbia's snow this week came, piled up on one mountain and left again. Western Serbia got the most: on Sunday 15 November the upper slopes of Tornik, Zlatibor's ski area, had 39 cm of snow. Three days later it was gone. Kopaonik, the country's biggest ski area, only saw a light dusting, and on Thursday 19 November no Serbian ski area has snow on the ground.

p: The snow that whitened Bosnia and Croatia on Friday 13 November also reached the hills of western Serbia. Tornik, whose lifts climb to 1,486 m above the Ribnica lake, went from 3 cm on its upper slopes on 13 November to 34 cm on Saturday 14 November and 39 cm on Sunday 15 November, the deepest snow anywhere in Serbia this week.

It did not last. By Monday 16 November there were 29 cm left, 5 cm on Tuesday 17 November, and the slopes were bare on Wednesday 18 November. That is a white weekend, not the start of the season, but it shows how quickly Zlatibor's higher ground can change.

In town the cover was thinner but real. The weather station in Zlatibor, at 1,029 m, measured 11 cm of snow on Saturday morning, 14 November, and 9 cm on Sunday. On Monday the ground was bare again. Sjenica, on the high Pešter plateau at 1,039 m, had 6 cm on Saturday and 4 cm on Sunday, then nothing.

The station on Kopaonik, at 1,713 m, tells the other half of the story: bare ground on Saturday, 2 cm on Sunday 15 November, bare again on Monday. The lowlands, from Novi Sad and Sombor to Kikinda, did not see lying snow at any morning reading of the week.

Kopaonik is high, with lifts up to 1,975 m, but it sat on the edge of this storm. Its upper slopes had about 2 cm of new snow on Saturday 14 November and 2 cm on the ground that day, and nothing since. Stara planina, near the Bulgarian border with lifts to 1,754 m, stayed bare all week, as did Divčibare, the ski hill near Valjevo that tops out at 1,088 m.
The smaller areas of the south-west, Iver and Putevi near Nova Varoš, saw a few centimetres of fresh snow on 13 and 14 November but nothing that stayed.

sections.h: Why the snow went so fast
p: Mid-November snow in Serbia usually falls on warm ground, at moderate heights, and it rarely survives the first sunny or mild day. Tornik's top lift is at 1,486 m and the weather station in Zlatibor town at 1,029 m: that is a good height for the first snow of the season but too low to keep it for long without steady cold.
The pattern this week was a cold blast from the north-west on Friday followed by milder air from Monday. Until December brings longer cold spells, every snowfall here is a few days' gift.

sections.h: The week ahead: little to come
p: The coming days do not bring a repeat. Friday 20 November is dry. Saturday 21 November could give up to 3 cm at the top of Kopaonik in the highest forecast, but the middle forecast keeps it dry. Monday 23 November brings a trace to Stara planina, about 1 cm, and Thursday 26 November about 1 cm on Tornik and Kopaonik in the highest forecasts.

For the whole week from 20 to 26 November the middle forecast gives about 1 cm on the upper slopes of Kopaonik (0 to 5 cm) and Stara planina (0 to 1 cm), and nothing on Tornik (0 to 2 cm) or Divčibare (0 to 1 cm). In other words: no new snow worth the drive before the end of the month.

sections.h: If you are planning to ski
p: Kopaonik and Stara planina rely on their own snow to open, so the first runs will depend on cold nights rather than on storms like last weekend's. Check the resorts' own channels before booking, and keep an eye on the forecast at the end of November.

If you want natural snow now, the nearest options are higher and further west: Durmitor in Montenegro still has a thin cover on Savin Kuk, and Slovenia's Julian Alps have fresh snow today. Bosnia and Herzegovina is bare and expecting snow later next week.

advice: Last weekend's snow on Zlatibor melted by Wednesday 18 November; all Serbian ski areas are bare today.
Little new snow is expected until 26 November, at most a few centimetres on Kopaonik.
Check Kopaonik's and Stara planina's own channels for opening news.

sr.title: Sneg u Srbiji ove nedelje: kratak beli vikend na Zlatiboru, Kopaonik još čeka
sr.description: Tornik na Zlatiboru imao je 15. novembra 2026. do 39 cm snega na gornjim stazama; do srede se otopio. Kopaonik je jedva pobeleo. Nedelja dan po dan i šta sledi.
sr.lede: Sneg je ove nedelje u Srbiji došao, nagomilao se na jednoj planini i otišao. Zapadna Srbija je dobila najviše: u nedelju 15. novembra gornje staze Tornika, skijališta na Zlatiboru, imale su 39 cm snega. Tri dana kasnije nije ga bilo. Kopaonik, najveće skijalište u zemlji, dobio je samo malo snega, a u četvrtak 19. novembra nijedno skijalište u Srbiji nema snega na tlu.

p: Sneg koji je u petak 13. novembra zabeleo Bosnu i Hrvatsku stigao je i do brda zapadne Srbije. Tornik, sa žičarama do 1486 m iznad jezera Ribnica, imao je 3 cm na gornjim stazama 13. novembra, 34 cm u subotu 14. novembra i 39 cm u nedelju 15. novembra, najdublji sneg u Srbiji ove nedelje.

Nije potrajao. Do ponedeljka 16. novembra ostalo je 29 cm, u utorak 17. novembra 5 cm, a u sredu 18. novembra staze su bile bez snega. To je beli vikend, a ne početak sezone, ali pokazuje koliko se brzo viši delovi Zlatibora menjaju.

U gradu je pokrivač bio tanji, ali stvaran. Meteorološka stanica Zlatibor, na 1029 m, izmerila je 11 cm snega u subotu ujutru 14. novembra i 9 cm u nedelju. U ponedeljak je tlo ponovo bilo golo. Sjenica, na visoravni Pešter na 1039 m, imala je 6 cm u subotu i 4 cm u nedelju, a zatim ništa.

Stanica na Kopaoniku, na 1713 m, priča drugu polovinu priče: golo tlo u subotu, 2 cm u nedelju 15. novembra, ponovo golo u ponedeljak. Ravnica, od Novog Sada i Sombora do Kikinde, nijednog jutra ove nedelje nije imala snega na tlu.

Kopaonik je visok, sa žičarama do 1975 m, ali je bio na ivici ove oluje. Gornje staze dobile su oko 2 cm novog snega u subotu 14. novembra, toliko je i ležalo tog dana, i ništa od tada. Stara planina, kod bugarske granice sa žičarama do 1754 m, bila je bez snega cele nedelje, kao i Divčibare kod Valjeva, čiji vrh staza je na 1088 m.
Manja skijališta na jugozapadu, Iver i Putevi kod Nove Varoši, dobila su nekoliko centimetara svežeg snega 13. i 14. novembra, ali ništa se nije zadržalo.

sections.h: Zašto se sneg tako brzo otopio
p: Sneg sredinom novembra u Srbiji obično pada na toplo tlo, na umerenim visinama, i retko preživi prvi sunčan ili blag dan. Gornja stanica Tornika je na 1486 m, a meteorološka stanica u gradu Zlatiboru na 1029 m: to je dobra visina za prvi sneg sezone, ali preniska da se zadrži dugo bez stalne hladnoće.
Ove nedelje obrazac je bio hladan prodor sa severozapada u petak, a od ponedeljka blaži vazduh. Dok decembar ne donese duže hladne periode, svaki sneg ovde je poklon od nekoliko dana.

Naredni dani ne donose ponavljanje. Petak 20. novembra je suv. Subota 21. novembra mogla bi u najvišoj prognozi doneti do 3 cm na vrh Kopaonika, ali srednja prognoza ostaje suva. Ponedeljak 23. novembra donosi trag snega na Staroj planini, oko 1 cm, a četvrtak 26. novembra oko 1 cm na Torniku i Kopaoniku u najvišim prognozama.

Za celu nedelju od 20. do 26. novembra srednja prognoza daje oko 1 cm na gornjim stazama Kopaonika (0 do 5 cm) i Stare planine (0 do 1 cm), a ništa na Torniku (0 do 2 cm) i Divčibarama (0 do 1 cm). Drugim rečima: do kraja meseca nema novog snega vrednog puta.

Kopaonik i Stara planina za otvaranje računaju na sopstveni sneg, pa će prve staze zavisiti od hladnih noći, a ne od oluja kao prošlog vikenda. Pre rezervacije proverite zvanične kanale skijališta i pratite prognozu krajem novembra.

Ako želite prirodan sneg sada, najbliže opcije su više i zapadnije: Durmitor u Crnoj Gori još ima tanak pokrivač na Savinom Kuku, a slovenačke Julijske Alpe danas imaju svež sneg. Bosna i Hercegovina je bez snega i očekuje ga krajem sledeće nedelje.

advice: Sneg sa prošlog vikenda na Zlatiboru otopio se do srede 18. novembra; sva skijališta u Srbiji danas su bez snega.
Do 26. novembra očekuje se malo novog snega, najviše nekoliko centimetara na Kopaoniku.
Za vesti o otvaranju proverite zvanične kanale Kopaonika i Stare planine.
